concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Full sweep, aggregation, analysis, and reproducibility
concerns.text: The specification (FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑003) requires the system to be deployable and operable on a *physical* mesh of heterogeneous consumer devices. The task list contains only mock‑node unit‑tests and CI‑only synthetic runs (T001‑T013) and does not include any concrete task that orchestrates a real‑hardware benchmark on an actual Wi‑Fi mesh. This constitutes a retroactive narrowing of the functional requirements, weakening the mandated physical‑testbed capability.

Constitution Principle VI mandates that the discrete‑event simulation model be validated against a small‑scale physical deployment (10–20 machines). No task in the list performs such a validation; all verification steps rely on mock data. This is a violation of the constitution’s simulation‑fidelity requirement.
